# Portfolio - Full-Stack Software Engineer
> Full-stack developer with 3+ years of experience building scalable web applications and APIs, currently at Rolls-Royce.

## Technical Expertise
Working across Angular, Node.js, Express, and cloud-based microservices on Azure. Additional hands-on experience in Java, Spring Boot, Hibernate, PL/SQL, React.js, Next.js, and CSS frameworks (Tailwind, DaisyUI, Bootstrap).

## Key Highlights
- Designed 70+ RESTful APIs, several serving 100,000+ daily requests at a 99.9% success rate.
- Built and maintained systems processing 100,000+ transactions monthly, improving speed by up to 30%.
- Integrated CI/CD pipelines and SonarQube for automated code quality gates in production environments.

## Algorithmic Problem Solving
Strong foundation in Data Structures and Algorithms. Currently ranked in the top 1.02% globally on [LeetCode](https://leetcode.com), with competitive programming results across CodeChef, Codeforces, and HackerRank.
